fusions.name: Venom Lunge
fusions.desc: Lunges a venomous bite that deals 12 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Patient Strike
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 14 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to this blow. It only strikes a target at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Coiled Poise
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Venom Carrier
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 10% poison resistance for as long as you carry it.
